title: Two-motorcycle collision leaves four injured in Bahia
seoTitle: Two-motorcycle collision injures four in Bahia
subtitle: The accident on BA-120 caused minor injuries and highlights a dangerous stretch of road
excerpt: On Tuesday morning, the 29th, two motorcycles collided on BA-120, between Conceição do Coité and Retirolândia, leaving four people injured.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Tuesday morning, the 29th, two motorcycles collided on BA-120, between Conceição do Coité and Retirolândia, leaving four people injured. The Brigada Águia Resgate rescued those involved and transported the 5-year-old victim for medical attention.

What happened on BA-120

The accident, captured by security cameras, involved a woman and her 5-year-old daughter, who sustained minor injuries and were taken to the hospital. The other two injured individuals did not require hospitalization and are doing well.

Stretch considered dangerous

According to Brigada Águia Resgate, the stretch where the collision occurred is considered dangerous. g1 is attempting to ascertain the road conditions and if there were factors that contributed to the collision.

Another accident in Santa Cruz

On the same day, in Santa Cruz do Sul, a traffic accident was reported at the intersection of Ernesto Alves and 28 de Setembro streets. A red Chevrolet Celta was traveling on Rua Ernesto Alves, while a black Ford Ka was on Rua 28 de Setembro. The side-impact collision resulted only in material damage, with no injuries.

No injuries in Santa Cruz

The traffic light at the location was functioning normally when the collision occurred. The Ford Ka even encroached upon a construction site, but the circumstances that led to the incident are still being investigated. The Municipal Guard responded to the occurrence and confirmed only material damage.

Authorities' reaction

In both cases, local authorities responded to the occurrences, and in Bahia, Brigada Águia Resgate provided immediate assistance. In Santa Cruz, the Municipal Guard was the first to arrive at the scene.

Conclusion

These incidents highlight the importance of increased attention on road stretches and intersections, especially when there are reports of danger and construction structures. The investigation into road conditions and factors contributing to the accidents remains ongoing.

With information from G1, Portal Arauto.
